text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has finally arrived!
While everyone is fired up for their next post-summer goals, Mejiro Ardan is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we've finally arrived at the training camp.
I could hardly wait for this.
choice_data_list: You look really happy, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, due to my physical condition, I haven't
really been able to fully participate in summer training camps until now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To repay all the training Trainer has given me up to today,
I intend to give this summer training camp everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, please don't hold back at all—
push me to my absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the intense summer training camp with Mejiro Ardan began!
